segments.text: While working in the laboratory, it will often be required to separate liquid mixtures or to purify liquid from non-volatile substances.
segments.zh: 在实验室工作时，经常需要分离液体混合物，或者把液体与不挥发性物质分开以纯化液体。

segments.text: This separation or purification can be done by utilizing the liquid's boiling point through a technique called distillation.
segments.zh: 这种分离或纯化可以利用液体的沸点，通过一种叫做蒸馏的技术来完成。

segments.text: Distillation works through the processes of vaporization and condensation.
segments.zh: 蒸馏是通过汽化和冷凝过程来实现的。

segments.text: Vaporization is the transformation of a liquid to a gas, and condensation is the conversion of a gaseous species into a liquid.
segments.zh: 汽化是液体转变为气体，冷凝则是气态物质转变为液体。

segments.text: To perform a distillation, a mixture of two miscible liquids is heated until the liquid with the higher vapor pressure reaches its boiling point.
segments.zh: 进行蒸馏时，把两种可互溶液体的混合物加热，直到蒸气压较高的那种液体达到其沸点。

segments.text: This vapor travels up the inside of the flask, through a distilling head, and into a condenser.
segments.zh: 这种蒸气沿烧瓶内部上升，经过蒸馏头，进入冷凝管。

segments.text: The cold water jacket on the condenser transforms the vapor back into liquid, which then travels into the receiving flask.
segments.zh: 冷凝管的冷水夹套使蒸气重新变成液体，液体随后流入接收瓶。

segments.text: In this manner, distillation effectively separates lower boiling point compounds from higher boiling point compounds.
segments.zh: 这样，蒸馏就能有效地把低沸点化合物与高沸点化合物分开。

segments.text: Three types of distillations are commonly used in the laboratory.
segments.zh: 实验室中常用的蒸馏有三种。

segments.text: Depending on your liquid solution, you will have to decide which type of distillation will be the most effective.
segments.zh: 根据你的液体溶液，你需要决定哪种蒸馏最有效。

segments.text: The first type of distillation is a simple distillation.
segments.zh: 第一种是简单蒸馏。

segments.text: This technique is used when separating miscible liquids that boil below 150 degrees Celsius at one atmosphere from either non-volatile impurities
segments.zh: 这种技术用于分离在 1 个大气压下沸点低于 150 摄氏度的可互溶液体，使之与不挥发性杂质分开，

segments.text: or from a second liquid that boils at least 25 degrees Celsius higher than the first.
segments.zh: 或与沸点比它至少高 25 摄氏度的第二种液体分开。

segments.text: The second type of distillation is the fractional distillation.
segments.zh: 第二种是分馏。

segments.text: This technique should be used to separate liquid mixtures that have less than a 25 degrees Celsius difference in boiling point.
segments.zh: 这种技术应用于分离沸点相差小于 25 摄氏度的液体混合物。

segments.text: The third type of distillation is a vacuum distillation.
segments.zh: 第三种是减压蒸馏。

segments.text: This technique should be used to separate miscible liquids that boil above 150 degrees Celsius at one atmosphere
segments.zh: 这种技术应用于分离在 1 个大气压下沸点高于 150 摄氏度的可互溶液体。

segments.text: In this video, Distillation Part 1, we will discuss simple and fractional distillations.
segments.zh: 在本视频《蒸馏（一）》中，我们将讨论简单蒸馏和分馏。

segments.text: In Distillation Part 2, we will discuss vacuum distillations.
segments.zh: 在《蒸馏（二）》中，我们将讨论减压蒸馏。

segments.text: To carry out a simple distillation, you will need a cork ring, a round bottom distilling flask, two ring stands,
segments.zh: 进行简单蒸馏，你需要一个软木圈、一个圆底蒸馏烧瓶、两个铁架台、

segments.text: a stir bar and magnetic stirrer, a distilling head, a condenser, a vacuum adapter, grease,
segments.zh: 一个搅拌子和磁力搅拌器、一个蒸馏头、一根冷凝管、一个真空接引管、真空脂、

segments.text: three yellow CAC clamps, a thermometer and thermometer adapter, three round bottom receiving flasks,
segments.zh: 三个黄色 Keck 夹、一支温度计和温度计套管、三个圆底接收瓶、

segments.text: two extension clamps and fasteners, a heating mantle, an iron ring, a variable voltage transformer or variac,
segments.zh: 两个延长夹和固定夹、一个加热套、一个铁圈、一台调压变压器（Variac）、

segments.text: three hose clips, two pieces of rubber tubing and a container for an ice water bath.
segments.zh: 三个软管夹、两根橡胶管，以及一个装冰水浴的容器。

segments.text: The first step in performing a distillation is choosing the proper size distillation flask.
segments.zh: 进行蒸馏的第一步是选择大小合适的蒸馏烧瓶。

segments.text: The distilling flask should not be more than half full or less than one third full when the distillation begins.
segments.zh: 蒸馏开始时，蒸馏烧瓶中的液体不应超过一半，也不应少于三分之一。

segments.text: If the flask is overfilled, the solution will likely overheat or bump into the condenser.
segments.zh: 如果烧瓶装得太满，溶液很可能会过热，或者暴沸冲入冷凝管。

segments.text: Bumping will cause impurities to be collected in the receiving flask, rendering the distillation worthless.
segments.zh: 暴沸会使杂质被收集到接收瓶中，使整个蒸馏白费。

segments.text: If the flask is less than a third full, then you'll have a greater chance of losing some product
segments.zh: 如果烧瓶装液少于三分之一，你损失部分产物的可能性就更大，

segments.text: because a substantial amount of the material will be needed just to fill the flask and distilling head with vapor.
segments.zh: 因为仅仅让蒸气充满烧瓶和蒸馏头就需要相当多的物料。

segments.text: While we're on the topic of size, we'd like to speak briefly about heating mantles.
segments.zh: 既然说到大小，我们顺便简单谈谈加热套。

segments.text: If you do not have an appropriately sized heating mantle, then use one that is too big.
segments.zh: 如果你没有大小合适的加热套，那就用一个偏大的。

segments.text: Never use a heating mantle that is too small because heat is not easily transferred between the mantle and flask due to poor contact,
segments.zh: 绝不要用太小的加热套，因为接触不良，热量不容易在加热套和烧瓶之间传递，

segments.text: which causes the mantle to burn out.
segments.zh: 这会导致加热套烧坏。

segments.text: If the mantle is too big for the flask, then add sand to fill in the empty space.
segments.zh: 如果加热套对于烧瓶来说太大，就加沙子填满空隙。

segments.text: After you have chosen a distilling flask, transfer your sample into it and add an appropriately sized stir bar.
segments.zh: 选好蒸馏烧瓶后，把样品转移进去，并加入一个大小合适的搅拌子。

segments.text: If you will not have access to a magnetic stirrer, then add a few boiling stones to the distilling flask instead.
segments.zh: 如果你没有磁力搅拌器可用，就改为往蒸馏烧瓶里加几粒沸石。

segments.text: The next step is the assembly of the distillation apparatus, which is likely one of the most difficult glassware assemblies you'll ever encounter.
segments.zh: 下一步是组装蒸馏装置，这很可能是你遇到过的最难组装的玻璃仪器之一。

segments.text: The neck of the distilling flask is clamped onto one of the ring stands with an extension clamp and fastener.
segments.zh: 用延长夹和固定夹把蒸馏烧瓶的瓶颈夹在其中一个铁架台上。

segments.text: A heating mantle, which is plugged into the variac, rests on an iron ring below the distilling flask.
segments.zh: 插在 Variac 上的加热套放在蒸馏烧瓶下方的铁圈上。

segments.text: If you're using a stir bar, then place a magnetic stirrer underneath the heating mantle.
segments.zh: 如果你用搅拌子，就把磁力搅拌器放在加热套下面。

segments.text: Leave enough room below the iron ring so that the heating mantle can be dropped away from the distilling flask if necessary.
segments.zh: 铁圈下方要留出足够空间，以便必要时能把加热套从蒸馏烧瓶下撤开。

segments.text: The distilling head is attached to the top of the distilling flask and a condenser is attached to the side arm of the distilling head.
segments.zh: 蒸馏头接在蒸馏烧瓶的顶部，冷凝管接在蒸馏头的侧管上。

segments.text: The vacuum adapter is attached to the other end of the condenser and this joint is attached to the second ring stand with an extension clamp and fastener.
segments.zh: 真空接引管接在冷凝管的另一端，并用延长夹和固定夹把这个接口固定在第二个铁架台上。

segments.text: A small receiving flask is clamped to the vacuum adapter with a yellow kec clamp and an ice water bath is placed underneath.
segments.zh: 用一个黄色 Keck 夹把一个小接收瓶夹在真空接引管上，下面放一个冰水浴。

segments.text: The thermometer and thermometer adapter are attached to the top of the distilling head and clamped in place with a green kec clamp.
segments.zh: 温度计和温度计套管装在蒸馏头的顶部，并用一个绿色 Keck 夹固定。

segments.text: The top of the thermometer bulb should be aligned with the bottom of the side arm on the distillation head.
segments.zh: 温度计水银球的上端应与蒸馏头侧管的下沿对齐。

segments.text: Yellow kec clamps are used to secure both ends of the condenser.
segments.zh: 冷凝管的两端都用黄色 Keck 夹固定。

segments.text: Rubber tubing is attached to the water inlet and outlet of the condenser and secured with hose clips.
segments.zh: 橡胶管接在冷凝管的进水口和出水口上，并用软管夹固定。

segments.text: Finally, place two clean dry receiving flasks near the distillation apparatus.
segments.zh: 最后，在蒸馏装置旁边放两个洁净干燥的接收瓶。

segments.text: Before continuing, confirm that all of the joints have been lightly greased and that no kec clamps are used on any joint that will become hot.
segments.zh: 在继续之前，确认所有接口都已薄薄地涂了真空脂，并且任何会变热的接口上都没有使用 Keck 夹。

segments.text: After assembling the distillation apparatus, attach the tubing at the bottom of the condenser to the water source.
segments.zh: 组装好蒸馏装置后，把冷凝管底部的橡胶管接到水源上。

segments.text: Place the end of the tubing at the top of the condenser into a sink.
segments.zh: 把冷凝管顶部那根橡胶管的末端放进水槽。

segments.text: Remember, water goes in at the bottom and out at the top to discourage the formation of air bubbles.
segments.zh: 记住，水从下口进、上口出，以避免形成气泡。

segments.text: Double check that all of the joints are secured with hose clips and start the water flow.
segments.zh: 再次检查所有接口是否都已用软管夹固定，然后开始通水。

segments.text: The water should flow at the slowest rate that is necessary to keep the condenser cold.
segments.zh: 水流应保持在能使冷凝管保持冷却所需的最慢速度。

segments.text: If the flow rate is too fast, the chance of the tubing popping off the condenser and spraying all over your workspace greatly increases.
segments.zh: 如果流速太快，橡胶管从冷凝管上脱落、把水喷得工作台到处都是的可能性就会大大增加。

segments.text: To perform this simple distillation, turn on the variac and heat the sample to a gentle boil.
segments.zh: 进行这次简单蒸馏时，打开 Variac，把样品加热至缓缓沸腾。

segments.text: Make sure that the vacuum adapter remains open to the air.
segments.zh: 确保真空接引管始终与大气相通。

segments.text: Never heat a closed system or it will explode.
segments.zh: 绝不要加热密闭体系，否则它会爆炸。

segments.text: A ring of condensate will move up the flask and into the distilling head.
segments.zh: 一圈冷凝液会沿着烧瓶上升，进入蒸馏头。

segments.text: When the vapor reaches the height of the thermometer bulb, the temperature reading will jump dramatically,
segments.zh: 当蒸气到达温度计水银球的高度时，温度读数会急剧上升，

segments.text: indicating the formation of a droplet of liquid on the thermometer bulb.
segments.zh: 这表明温度计水银球上形成了液滴。

segments.text: If the condensate ring completely stops rising at any point, slightly increase the setting on the variac.
segments.zh: 如果冷凝液圈在任何时候完全停止上升，就稍微调高 Variac 的设定值。

segments.text: After the vapor reaches the condenser, it transforms back into liquid, flows down the condenser, and into a small receiving flask.
segments.zh: 蒸气到达冷凝管后，重新变成液体，沿冷凝管流下，进入小接收瓶。

segments.text: When approximately 10 drops have been collected in the small receiving flask, quickly replace it with the larger one.
segments.zh: 当小接收瓶中收集到大约 10 滴时，迅速把它换成大接收瓶。

segments.text: The first couple of drops of a distillation are always discarded because they may contain some lower boiling impurities.
segments.zh: 蒸馏最初的几滴总是要弃去，因为它们可能含有一些低沸点杂质。

segments.text: At this point, the distillate should be dropping into the receiving flask at a rate of 10 drops per minute.
segments.zh: 此时，馏出液应以每分钟 10 滴的速度滴入接收瓶。

segments.text: If the rate is faster, then the heat is too high and higher boiling point impurities may have escaped into the receiving flask.
segments.zh: 如果速度更快，说明加热太强，高沸点杂质可能已经跑进了接收瓶。

segments.text: If the rate is too slow, then the distillation will occur over too long of a time period.
segments.zh: 如果速度太慢，蒸馏所需的时间就会太长。

segments.text: After the lower boiling liquid has been completely distilled, no drop of liquid will be on the thermometer bulb and the temperature will plunge dramatically.
segments.zh: 低沸点液体完全蒸出后，温度计水银球上就不再有液滴，温度会急剧下降。

segments.text: At this point, immediately replace the large receiving flask with a new small receiving flask to collect the last few drops of liquid.
segments.zh: 这时，立即把大接收瓶换成一个新的小接收瓶，收集最后几滴液体。

segments.text: These drops may contain some higher boiling impurities that should not be collected in the main receiving flask.
segments.zh: 这几滴可能含有一些高沸点杂质，不应收集到主接收瓶中。

segments.text: Record the temperature range of when the mixture first started to boil until right before the dramatic drop in temperature.
segments.zh: 记录从混合物刚开始沸腾到温度急剧下降之前的温度范围。

segments.text: This is the boiling point of the distillate.
segments.zh: 这就是馏出液的沸点。

segments.text: If the range is within 2 degrees Celsius, your distillate is fairly pure.
segments.zh: 如果这个范围在 2 摄氏度以内，你的馏出液就相当纯了。

segments.text: After you have collected the final few drops of liquid, turn off the heat source.
segments.zh: 收集完最后几滴液体后，关闭热源。

segments.text: A simple distillation is performed more effectively if certain guidelines are followed.
segments.zh: 遵循以下准则，简单蒸馏会进行得更有效。

segments.text: First, make sure all the joints on the apparatus are tight and that the water lines are secured.
segments.zh: 第一，确保装置上的所有接口都已紧密连接，水管也已固定好。

segments.text: Second, fill the distilling flask between 1 third and 1 half full prior to distillation.
segments.zh: 第二，蒸馏前，蒸馏烧瓶的装液量应在三分之一到二分之一之间。

segments.text: Third, allow the distillation to proceed at a rate of 10 drops per minute.
segments.zh: 第三，让蒸馏以每分钟 10 滴的速度进行。

segments.text: Fourth, use separate receiving flasks for the beginning, middle, and end of the distillation to disallow low and high boiling impurities into the distillate.
segments.zh: 第四，蒸馏的开始、中间和末尾阶段使用不同的接收瓶，以免低沸点和高沸点杂质混入馏出液。

segments.text: Fifth, never let the distillation flask run dry.
segments.zh: 第五，绝不要把蒸馏烧瓶蒸干。

segments.text: A flask that is allowed to run dry may overheat and break.
segments.zh: 蒸干的烧瓶可能会过热并破裂。

segments.text: The second type of distillation that we will cover is the fractional distillation.
segments.zh: 我们要讲的第二种蒸馏是分馏。

segments.text: This technique should be used if you need to separate two liquids that have a small difference in boiling point, less than 25 degrees Celsius.
segments.zh: 如果你需要分离沸点相差较小（小于 25 摄氏度）的两种液体，就应使用这种技术。

segments.text: A fractional distillation is more effective at separating liquids with similar boiling points because it utilizes a fractionating column.
segments.zh: 分馏在分离沸点相近的液体时更有效，因为它使用了分馏柱。

segments.text: A fractionating column contains column packing with a large surface area and works by promoting a lot of tiny distillations on the surface of this packing.
segments.zh: 分馏柱中装有表面积很大的填料，其工作原理是促使在填料表面发生许多次微小的蒸馏。

segments.text: Specifically, when the liquid mixture is heated to boiling, the resulting vapor is richer in the lower boiling component.
segments.zh: 具体来说，当液体混合物被加热至沸腾时，产生的蒸气中低沸点组分的含量更高。

segments.text: The vapor moves out of the flask and condenses on the bottom few centimeters of the fractionating column.
segments.zh: 蒸气离开烧瓶，在分馏柱底部几厘米处冷凝。

segments.text: Now, the condensed droplet is richer in lower boiling component and the liquid in the distilling flask is richer in the higher boiling component.
segments.zh: 这时，冷凝下来的液滴中低沸点组分更多，而蒸馏烧瓶中的液体则高沸点组分更多。

segments.text: If that liquid droplet is reheated, it will vaporize and condense a little further up the fractionating column.
segments.zh: 如果这个液滴被再次加热，它就会汽化，并在分馏柱上稍高一点的地方冷凝。

segments.text: This distillate will have an even higher percentage of the lower boiling component.
segments.zh: 这部分馏出物中低沸点组分的比例还会更高。

segments.text: This process is repeated until the vapor reaches the top of the fractionating column where, theoretically, it should be pure in lower boiling component.
segments.zh: 这个过程不断重复，直到蒸气到达分馏柱的顶部，理论上此时它应该是纯的低沸点组分。

segments.text: To assemble the apparatus for a fractional distillation, place a fractionating column between the distillation flask and the distillation head.
segments.zh: 组装分馏装置时，在蒸馏烧瓶和蒸馏头之间加装一根分馏柱。

segments.text: Alternatively, your lab may have all-in-one distillation glassware that contains a fractionating column.
segments.zh: 或者，你的实验室可能有带分馏柱的一体式蒸馏玻璃仪器。

segments.text: Perform the fractional distillation in the same manner as the simple distillation.
segments.zh: 分馏的操作方式与简单蒸馏相同。

segments.text: To ensure an effective fractional distillation, heat the distilling flask very slowly.
segments.zh: 为确保分馏有效，要非常缓慢地加热蒸馏烧瓶。

segments.text: Too much heat causes the distillation to occur too rapidly, disallowing the liquid vapor equilibria on the surface of the fractionating column.
segments.zh: 加热太强会使蒸馏进行得太快，无法在分馏柱表面建立液-汽平衡。

segments.text: If too little heat is used, then the column may lose heat faster than it can be warmed up by the vapor, preventing the vapor from reaching the top of the column.
segments.zh: 如果加热太弱，分馏柱散热可能比被蒸气加热得更快，使蒸气无法到达柱顶。

segments.text: If the column seems to be losing heat faster than it can be warmed up by the vapor, you may insulate the column by wrapping it with glass wool or cotton and aluminum foil.
segments.zh: 如果分馏柱看起来散热比被蒸气加热得更快，可以用玻璃棉或棉花和铝箔包裹柱子进行保温。

segments.text: As a general rule, a slow, steady distillation where one drop is collected every two to three seconds is reasonable.
segments.zh: 一般来说，缓慢、稳定地蒸馏，每两到三秒收集一滴，是比较合适的。

segments.text: Distillation is an effective technique for separating and purifying liquids.
segments.zh: 蒸馏是分离和纯化液体的一种有效技术。

segments.text: When used correctly, pure compounds and good yields are readily attained.
segments.zh: 只要使用得当，就能很容易地得到纯化合物和较好的产率。
